summary_en: 500,000 shares (1.7% of shares outstanding) to be acquired for ¥625.0M maximum via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-13 at ¥1,250/share (closing price 2026-07-10). Single-execution block; results to be announced after market close. Part of medium-term capital allocation plan to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Auction Equity Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Daito Pharmaceutical announced on 2026-07-10 that its board resolved to acquire 500,000 treasury shares (1.7% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥625.0M via a single off-auction block trade (ToSTNeT-3) on 2026-07-13 at 08:45 JST. The purchase price is set at ¥1,250/share, the closing price on 2026-07-10. The transaction is a one-time block execution; partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be announced after market close on 2026-07-13. The acquisition is part of the company's medium-term capital plan to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. As of 2026-06-30, the company held 16,718 treasury shares (excluding 94,340 shares held in trust for executive stock grants) out of 28,838,162 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
